hooks.name: Lint JS on Save
hooks.description: Runs ESLint on any .js file whenever it is saved, giving immediate feedback on code style violations.

action.command: cd /d v:\kiro-university-project && npx eslint --no-eslintrc -c .eslintrc.json "%file%" 2>&1 && echo "ESLint passed" || echo "ESLint found issues - check output above"
